# h2o / h2o-fuzzer-url

h2o's own fuzz target `h2o-fuzzer-url` ([source](source/driver_url.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over h2o (h2o/h2o at cac7e656).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: If h2o_url_parse succeeds (ret != -1), the parsed url must have a non-NULL scheme.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against h2o at commit cac7e656.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- If h2o_url_parse succeeds (ret != -1), the parsed url must have a non-NULL scheme ([lines 39-42](source/driver_url.cc#L39-L42)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- After a successful parse, the count of non-NUL bytes across url.authority, url.host and url.path must be at most 2*Size: a loose sanity bound on the parsed component lengths (it touches every byte of each component, so ASan also checks they are readable) ([lines 50-52](source/driver_url.cc#L50-L52)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch h2o` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `h2o-fuzzer-url.plain` | 48,608 | `b7410e44d371a8762a64123c3d844d822a82b9efc17c78ad0eb090d2082d5cdd` |
| ubsan | `h2o-fuzzer-url.ubsan` | 49,672 | `8a24f99614d6c94cd1ae0173b0edba806986eddf8044cd0eb249c4524a6c1401` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
